name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc41): on a screen that is still on the Classic UI, an edit to an existing grid row through the modern-UI tools was silently dropped, and the same tools read that grid back with empty values. Found on Chart of Accounts (GL202500) on a 2026R1 site whose screens default to the Classic UI. The tools now notice a grid that comes back with only its key column, read it again the way the Modern UI does and carry on that way, so the read shows the real values and the edit is saved. An edit the screen shows no sign of taking is no longer reported as done when the read-back check is switched off. Adding rows was never affected, and screens on the Modern UI behave as before. Not yet checked on a 2025R1 site. rc40's fixes stand: a record opened by its key is checked before it is written to, and Row Sets (CS206010) can be edited on 2026R1. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
